newsitem.title: FINLAND: MILLENNIUM CUT-OFF TO CHANGE TT TIETO.
newsitem.headline: MILLENNIUM CUT-OFF TO CHANGE TT TIETO.

text.p: Finnish data systems and services group TT Tieto Oy said on Thursday its growth outlook, now fuelled by the run-up to the European single currency, would change after the year 2000.
"In our own growth we have to take account of the fact that circumstances will change after the year 2000," CEO Matti Lehti told a news conference on the company's first report.

Tieto said earlier in the report its expert information technology services for banking, insurance, service, public administration and industry had been in particular demand due to preparations for EMU and the year 2000. @
It said strong demand would continue for the next few years. Lehti did not specify what if any measures Tieto planned to offset the end of those particular growth drivers.
